description: This file defines the FeaturePropertyModifiedStrategy class, which handles FeaturePropertyModified events in a Java project. It extends an abstract event strategy class and applies modifications to a ThingBuilder based on the event data.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles FeaturePropertyModified events, applying property modifications to ThingBuilder instances.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies a FeaturePropertyModified event to a ThingBuilder to update feature property values.
